card.name: Linking words before seasons and dates
card.fires_on: Small linking words like this, on, in and of that come right before a season, month or date, such as summer, winter, spring or a named day.

modes.label: this + season
modes.description: The word this right before a season or holiday period.
modes.example: If you plan to spend much time outdoors<< this>> summer, you might want to make sure

modes.label: on/in/of + date
modes.description: A preposition before a month, season or calendar day.
modes.example: The Lipica Open is an international orienteering competition that is held every year at the beginning<< of>> March.

card.writes: It seems to raise the chance of a season or month name coming next, though the listed tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a season or date, like "this" in "this summer".
